formula: Each team scores league mean + its offense residual + opponent defense residual, then receives ±1.5 points for home court (zero at neutral sites). Residuals adjust for opponents over six passes and shrink toward zero using five prior games. Weights halve every 14 days. The first half is fitted separately from actual first-half scores with ±0.75 points for home court.
